note: Card value tiers (docs/card-rewards.md, 25 Sep 2026). `demand` is a 0-100 JUDGEMENT score of how much children and fans want the card: global fame, current superstar status, iconic moments and major honours (Ballon d'Or, World Cup, FIFA awards). It is not follower data and cites no numbers. Women's players are scored by their own fans' demand and futsal players on the futsal community's scale, so each game has its icons. Tiers are derived: demand >= thresholds.icon is an Icon, >= thresholds.elite is Elite, the rest Regular. To move a card, change its demand, or pin it with `overrides` (name -> icon|elite|regular). Players missing here count as Regular.
